in_sanskrit.name: द्हीर
in_sanskrit.meaning: बड़े पराक्रमदार, वीर, ठाकुर, आत्मविशद, कोटीबालक, स्थिर, अभयरूपी, सम्रत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is full of valor and courage, a hero, a strong and fearless person, steadfast, a person with great wisdom and intelligence, a king, and a person who is free from fear.

in_hindi.name: धीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: A brave and valorous man, a virtuous person.

in_tamil.name: தீர்
in_tamil.meaning: வீரம் செய்யதில்லையில்லை, அவ்விருந்தம், அதிகம் விருத்தம், கட்டளையானம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: A person who is free from cowardice, a hero, a strong and powerful person, a steadfast person.

in_telugu.name: ధీర్
in_telugu.meaning: అధిక పరాక్రమదేశ, అధిక పృథ్థిజ్జనేశ, అధిక మృగేశ, అధిక మృగేశ్య, అధిక పోయేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A person who is full of valor and courage, a hero, a king, a powerful and fearless person.

in_marathi.name: Dheer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheer is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dhira’ meaning ‘calm, stable, and steady’. In Hindu mythology, Dheer is a name for Lord Shiva, representing his unwavering nature and immense power.
